description: This Java source file contains a test class 'Containers' used for managing and ensuring the startup of database containers (MySQL and PostgreSQL) for testing purposes in the OpenMRS project. It includes methods to initialize, start, and configure the containers, and set system properties for runtime database connection.

classes.name: Containers
classes.description: A utility class for managing MySQL and PostgreSQL test containers, setting up database configurations, and initializing schemas for testing.

methods.name: ensureDatabaseRunning
methods.description: Checks if either MySQL or PostgreSQL container is running and starts PostgreSQL if the system property indicates it.

methods.name: ensureMySQLRunning
methods.description: Initializes and starts a MySQLContainer with specific configurations and sets related system properties.

methods.name: ensurePostgreSQLRunning
methods.description: Initializes and starts a PostgreSQLContainer with specific configurations and sets related system properties.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Sets runtime properties and invokes schema creation for the database used in testing.
